FitGOAT – Your Personal AI-Powered Fitness & Nutrition Coach

Whether you’re looking to build muscle, lose weight, or improve overall wellness, FitGOAT provides the tools and insights to help you optimize your journey without guesswork.

How It Works:

Simply scan your body, log your meals, or scan food items to receive instant data-driven recommendations. FitGOAT’s AI analyzes your body composition, calorie intake, and fitness activity to generate custom plans that fit your goals.

Key Features:

Personalized Workout Plans – Get customized fitness routines based on your body scan and goals.

Tailored Meal Plans – Receive AI-driven meal suggestions that align with your fitness objectives.

Exercise Logging – Track your workouts, monitor progress, and stay on top of your routine.

Meal Logging – Record what you eat and gain insights into your daily nutritional intake.

Food Scanner with Calorie Calculation – Scan any food item to instantly analyze its calorie and nutrient content.

Body Scan with Fat Percentage Calculation – Measure and track body composition changes over time.

Calorie Tracking – Monitor daily intake and ensure you stay within your nutritional goals.

Advanced Analytics – Gain insights into your fitness and nutrition trends with data-driven reports.

Understand Your BMI
FitGOAT calculates your Body Mass Index (BMI) to help you better understand your health status over time.

What is BMI? Body Mass Index is a measure of a person’s weight in relation to their height. It helps categorize your health based on body composition.

Metric Formula: BMI = weight(kg) / height(m)²

Imperial Formula: BMI = (weight(lbs) / height(in)²) × 703

BMI Categories:

Underweight: BMI less than 18.5

Healthy Weight: BMI 18.5 to 24.9

Overweight: BMI 25 to 29.9

Obese: BMI 30 and above

FitGOAT helps you track these changes over time, offering a clearer picture of your progress beyond just weight.

Unlike generic fitness apps, FitGOAT takes a data-backed approach to health optimization. No complicated setups, no one-size-fits-all programs—just scan, track, and get personalized fitness and nutrition guidance. Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned athlete, FitGOAT helps you make smarter decisions and achieve better results.

Start your transformation today with FitGOAT! Want to achieve your fitness goals faster? FitGOAT is your all-in-one fitness and nutrition companion, designed to personalize your journey based on your body’s unique needs.

record.name: Motra AI Workout Fitness Coach
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Motra (formerly known as Train Fitness) is the first app to offer automatic exercise tracking, using only the motion of your Apple Watch. Trusted by 100,000+ weight lifters, Motra is the future of AI + gym workouts.

Our application monitors the motion of your Apple Watch, tracking reps for over 470 unique exercise types – completely hands free! Our app will track push ups, bicep curls, 12 types of bench press, squats, deadlifts, and hundreds more! No more manually logging each set.

This automatic tracking is made possible by our patented Neural Kinetic Profiling, an advancement in AI that allows workout tracking using wrist motion. 

Unsure what to do at the gym? Using the Motra app, you can generate workouts based on your recovery, goals, and fitness data with the help of AI. Our Smart Weights system will recommend specific workout plans, exercises, sets, and weight… entirely customized to you! Let artificial intelligence build the best possible workout for you, and stop guessing what to do at the gym.  

We built Motra because we too are lifters, gym enthusiasts, & fellow athletes, and we're tired of entering a workout log, manually. We believe that a gym workout tracker should be as easy as recording a run, and we’ll stop at nothing to get there. The Motra App is an all-encompassing workout log app that tracks how you move and helps you achieve your strength training goals at the gym. Simply strap on your Apple Watch, and see the magic unfold.

Our application runs on the Apple Watch Series 4 and newer. Unfortunately, we do not support the Apple Watch 1, 2 and 3.

We are very serious about data. We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Our data storage practices are designed to enhance user experience without compromising privacy. We only retain the essential data needed for a seamless experience. Please see our Privacy Policy & Commitment below for more details.

Any purchases will be applied to your iCloud account at the end of your free trial. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime directly from your iCloud account, or on the Motra application. For more information, see our terms of service or privacy policy.

Privacy Commitment: https://motra.com/privacycommitment
Privacy Policy: https://motra.com/privacy
Terms and Conditions: https://motra.com/terms

record.description_evidence:
AI health coach for lasting weight loss

Simple helps you lose weight with personalized plans, real-time nutrition analysis, on-demand coaching, and tailored workouts—without calorie counting or extreme restrictions. 
For the first time, progress actually feels fun. Think of us as the Duolingo of health: motivating, enjoyable, and surprisingly delightful. While other solutions push extremes, Simple helps you find a balance that keeps you smiling throughout your weight loss journey. Consistency, made easy.

What you get with Simple
An AI coach trained by experts
Avo™ is your smart in-app coach, guiding you with personalized advice, motivational coaching, and science-backed strategies—anytime, anywhere.

Instant food feedback with Avo Vision
Snap a photo of your groceries, menu, or meal and get instant guidance, nutrition insights, and recipe ideas. No calorie math—just clear, actionable advice on the go.

Easy, personalized workouts
Get simple, beginner-friendly workout plans designed to match your fitness level and goals. Build strength, burn calories, and stay consistent with exercise routines you’ll actually enjoy.

A real-time Success Score, designed to keep you on track
Track progress in real time with your personalized Success Score. Instantly see how your choices stack up, understand where to adjust, and stay motivated as you move closer to your goals.

Sustainable results without the stress
Turn small daily choices into lasting habits so you can lose weight, feel better, and stay consistent without rigid dieting.

Meet Blinky: your emotional support fluff
Most weight loss apps give you charts and streaks. Simple gives you Blinky.
He’s playful, dramatic, and impossible to ignore. Log a salad, he cheers. Log late-night fries, he’ll indulge with you while helping you get back on track. Skip logging, and he sulks—or goes full chaos.
Blinky makes consistency fun:
- Daily motivation—“What will Blinky say today?”
- Playful accountability—reactions that keep you logging.
- Streak rewards—stay consistent and earn golden Blinky.

It’s accountability without the scolding. His moods keep you engaged, entertained, and coming back—making healthy habits stick and driving real weight loss.

Features you’ll love
- Personalized weight loss coaching from Avo™
- Photo-based nutrition feedback with Avo Vision
- Beginner-friendly, personalized workout plans
- Honest, playful motivation from Blinky
- Quick food, water, activity, and weight logging
- iOS Home Screen widget & Apple Health + Watch integration

Why Simple works
Weight loss isn’t about perfection—it’s about consistency. Simple makes logging easy, workouts approachable, and healthy choices fun, so you can build habits that last.

That’s why people call us the “Duolingo of Health.” We turn hard work into something enjoyable, motivating, and even delightful. Where other apps feel clinical or restrictive, Simple keeps you smiling, laughing, and coming back for more.

And it works. To date, Simple serves 800,000+ active subscribers, who have collectively lost more than 17.5 million pounds. With 20M+ downloads and an average 4.7-star rating, Simple ranks among the world’s top-rated wellness apps.

We’ve also been recognized globally—named among the Top 100 AI Companies by the World Future Awards (2025) and awarded Best Virtual Health Coach by MedTech Breakthrough (2025). Our methods are backed by science, published in peer-reviewed journals, and presented at leading international conferences.

For further information, please visit https://support.apple.com/en-gb/HT202039.

• Create an unlimited number of routines
• Hundreds of exercises with free high-quality videos for you to focus on your form
• Customizable workouts: remove, adjust, or add exercises to suit your preferences

• Evidence-based nutrition advice to support your fitness journey
• Food tracker to easily log your daily intake of calories, protein, carbs, and fat
• User-friendly interface for tracking meals, snacks, and macros
• Comprehensive dashboard displaying your daily fitness and nutrition progress
• Adapt syncs with HealthKit; this feature can be turned on in the settings
• See your strength levels on your favorite exercises.

APPLE WATCH
• Use your Adapt Workouts on your Apple Watch
• Live sync your Apple Watch Workout with your iPhone
• Effortlessly track your sets
• Get notified when it's time for your next set
• Watch workouts automatically save when reconnecting to iPhone

[ WORKOUT PLANNER ]
• Let the AI Workout Planner build you a custom workout plan; it's like a personal AI fitness trainer.
• Build personalized workout plans based on your goals, experience, available time, and equipment.
• Adapt your workouts by adding, removing, or modifying exercises to fit your needs.
• Science-driven workouts with progressive overload and auto-regulation ensure continued progress.

• Track calories, protein, carbs, and fats with our easy-to-use food tracker.
• Receive personalized nutrition advice aligned with your goals.
• Search for foods or quickly add macros to monitor your diet accurately.


[ DASHBOARD TO TRACK YOUR PROGRESS ]
• Stay on top of your fitness goals with a clear daily overview of your workouts and nutrition.
• Monitor your weight, calorie intake, steps, and hydration to stay in control of your health journey.


[ SCIENCE-BASED TRAINING ]
• Experience the benefits of a progressive overload algorithm that tailors your workouts based on past achievements.

[ CUSTOM WORKOUTS ]
• Adjust, remove, or add exercises to suit your preferences and keep workouts engaging.

record.name: Cubex Fitness: AI Coach
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
250+ AI-built workout programs, live heart rate on your wrist and screen, and a full training journal — free, offline, no account. Nothing locked, ever.

Answer a few quick questions and Cubex matches you with the AI-built program that fits your goal, level, and equipment — you're training within a minute of opening the app.

Cubex Fitness was built by a former professional athlete and amateur boxer who got tired of apps that promise miracles and lock the real features behind a paywall. This one is different: everything is included, everything is free, and the only thing that creates results is your own consistency.

WHAT'S IN THE APP

• Personalized start: tell the app your goal, level, and where you train — it recommends the right AI-built program and gets you into your first workout in under a minute.
• 250+ AI-built workout programs, designed and balanced by AI for different ages, for men and women, from beginner to pro level.
• 300 exercises covering 14 muscle groups and 24 equipment types, with clear guidance and a one-tap YouTube video demo for every movement.
• Live heart rate while you train — connect Apple Health and see your pulse right on the workout screen, with heart-rate history saved into your journal.
• One-button workouts — the whole session runs on a single button: one tap moves you through sets, rest, and exercises. The app decides what's next; you just press GO.
• Apple Watch app — your session mirrored on the wrist: exercise, set, timers and the GO/REST button that drives the workout. It launches itself when you start training and keeps recording your heart rate.
• Live Activities & Dynamic Island — run your whole session from the lock screen with a single button. No unlocking, no thinking.
• Super-sets: group exercises back-to-back with no rest between them, exactly like on a real training floor.
• A real session engine: rep sets and timed sets, per-exercise rest timers, live calorie burn, and Easy or Advanced mode depending on how much control you want.
• Free Workout mode: start an empty session and build it as you go.
• Adaptive step goal that starts at 5,000 steps a day and grows with you as you keep hitting it.
• Train for any goal: burn fat, build muscle, increase stamina, improve flexibility, tone your body, stay fit, or recover from injury.
• 11 training styles: gym, home, outdoor, CrossFit, functional, cardio, boxing, HIIT, stretching, recovery, and yoga.
• A full workout journal and history of everything you've done, set by set.
• Progress charts and goals: weight, calories, per-exercise records, and body measurements.
• Built-in Timer and Tabata for fast, focused sessions.
• Make it yours: build your own programs, workouts, and exercises, and design custom charts and goals.

WHY CUBEX FITNESS IS DIFFERENT

Built by an athlete, not a marketing team. The programming comes from someone who actually trained and competed.

Genuinely free. No hidden fees, no locked "premium" features, no subscription, no ads. The whole app is yours.

Works offline, no account required. Your data stays on your device — all your activity, history, heart rate, and measurements are stored locally. Your progress belongs to you.

One app instead of a stack. Cubex Fitness replaces an AI coach, a heart-rate monitor app, and a paper notebook, so your daily training has everything it needs in one place.

You shape what's next. Need a feature? Ask the team and leave a review — good ideas land in future updates.

Available in 12 languages.

Download Cubex Fitness, start training, and let your consistency do the talking.

record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Cora: Your Personal Fitness Coach

Cora is an AI fitness coach that builds personalized plans across training, nutrition, sleep and recovery, and healthy habits. Tell Cora your goals, schedule, current level, preferences, and limitations. Connect Apple Health so Cora can use your own data to make the guidance more relevant.

Cora keeps coaching after the plan is built. When your schedule, sleep, recovery, travel, or missed workouts change, Cora helps adjust what comes next.

Ask Cora to:

• Build a strength plan around three days in the gym
• Adjust this week after poor sleep or a missed workout
• Plan meals around your calorie, macro, and training targets
• Find a restaurant meal that fits your targets, then log it
• Explain changes in your sleep, recovery, strain, or fitness
• Help you build routines and stay consistent

TRAINING

Get strength and cardio plans based on your goals, current level, schedule, equipment, and recovery. Plan your week, follow each workout, log sets and reps, track muscle recovery, and see how your training changes over time.

NUTRITION

Set calorie, macro, and micronutrient targets. Log food by typing what you ate, scanning a barcode, or taking a photo. Ask Cora for a meal plan, recipe, breakfast idea, or restaurant option that fits what you have left.

SLEEP AND RECOVERY

See daily and weekly sleep insights, recovery, Body Charge, and strain in one place. Cora explains the numbers, connects them to your training, and helps you decide when to push or take it easier.

HEALTHY HABITS

Create routines, track streaks, and connect daily habits to the goals you care about.

CHAT WITH CORA ANYWHERE

Chat with Cora in the app or through iMessage to ask questions, log food, check your plan, and get coaching without changing your routine.

Connect Cora to supported AI assistants through Model Context Protocol (MCP). With your permission, you can check your stats and plans, ask Cora questions, log meals or workouts, and update your training plan from the AI apps you already use.

APPLE HEALTH AND WEARABLES

Connect Apple Health and your existing wearable so Cora can use your workouts, sleep, heart rate, recovery, and activity data in its coaching. No extra band or device required.

WHAT ELSE YOU CAN DO IN THE CORA APP:

• Chat with Cora in the app or through iMessage
• Connect supported AI assistants to Cora through MCP
• Sync a compatible wearable through Apple Health
• Track live workouts on iPhone and Apple Watch, including heart rate zones and cardio goal notifications
• See daily sleep, recovery, Body Charge, and strain scores
• Review workout breakdowns, muscle recovery, training load, and fitness trends
• Set personalized weekly strength and cardio goals with AI recommendations
• Track resting heart rate, VO₂ max, heart rate recovery, and other fitness metrics
• Log meals by text, photo, or barcode
• Track calories, macros, and micronutrients
• Build meal plans and get healthy food recommendations
• Create and track habits and streaks
• Add widgets to check progress at a glance

GET STARTED: Answer a few basic bio questions and sync your Apple Health data to setup your profile, set goals, and initialize personalized training plans.

APP REQUIRES A SUBSCRIPTION (see more below in our terms of service). 

Download Cora today and start improving your fitness!

NOTE: Seek a doctor's advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions.
